paragraphs: In [Zevachim 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.38a.9) Rava said: “Bar Ada Mari explained it to me.” Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Ada Mari.[^1]

notes.text: [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=216&lang=en) quotes Rava’s words here with Bar Ada Mari, matching the linked Bavli. The alternative Rav Ada Mari in Dikdukei Soferim is given as Hyman’s reading report.
